# Run Contract — Quality Playbook run-layout invariants (linux-virtio)

> Generated by [Quality Playbook](https://github.com/andrewstellman/quality-playbook) v1.6.0 — Andrew Stellman
> Date: 2026-07-19 · Project: linux-virtio (sparse kernel subsystem checkout @ bfe62a454542)

This file records **the Quality Playbook's own run-layout invariants for this run** — where this
run is required to place its artifacts. These are *not* requirements of the audited system. The
Linux virtio driver subsystem neither knows nor cares where `quality/writeups/` lives; nothing
below constrains virtio's behavior.

The product specification for the audited system is `quality/REQUIREMENTS.md`. Read that file for
what virtio is required to do.

These records live in the same `quality/requirements_manifest.json` as the product requirements —
only their rendering destination differs. They are identified mechanically: a requirement whose
`references[]` point exclusively into `quality/` is a tool-contract requirement. They remain
gate-enforced per run; the Phase 6 gate enforces the workspace prohibition (REQ-017) mechanically
via `check_no_workspace_dir`, and the others give human reviewers concrete requirements to grep
for in compliance audits.

## Artifact location

The canonical Quality Playbook artifact layout, converted from prose guidance into testable
requirements. Every path below is relative to the audited repository root.

### REQ-010: Per-bug writeups are placed at quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md
- Tier: inferred — from QPB layout contract
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: Each confirmed bug has a self-contained writeup at
  `quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md`.

### REQ-011: Fix patches are placed at quality/patches/BUG-<id>-fix.patch
- Tier: inferred — from QPB layout contract
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: Each fix patch is named `quality/patches/BUG-<id>-fix.patch`.

### REQ-012: Regression-test patches are placed at quality/patches/BUG-<id>-regression-test.patch
- Tier: inferred — from QPB layout contract
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: Each regression-test patch is named
  `quality/patches/BUG-<id>-regression-test.patch`.

### REQ-013: Code review output is placed at quality/code_reviews/
- Tier: inferred — from QPB layout contract
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: Code review reports are written under `quality/code_reviews/`.

### REQ-014: Spec audit outputs (auditor reports + triage) are placed at quality/spec_audits/
- Tier: inferred — from QPB layout contract
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: Individual auditor reports and the triage synthesis are written
  under `quality/spec_audits/`.

### REQ-015: Sidecar JSON results (tdd-results.json, integration-results.json, recheck-results.json) are placed at quality/results/
- Tier: inferred — from QPB layout contract
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: All sidecar JSON result files are written under `quality/results/`.

### REQ-016: Mechanical-verification artifacts (verify.py + *_cases.txt) are placed at quality/mechanical/
- Tier: inferred — from QPB layout contract
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: `verify.py` and the extracted `*_cases.txt` files live under
  `quality/mechanical/`.

### REQ-017: quality/workspace/<name>/ is forbidden — top-level quality/<name>/ is the only canonical layout
- Tier: inferred — from QPB layout contract (Phase 6 gate check_no_workspace_dir)
- References: quality/
- Conditions of satisfaction: No `quality/workspace/` tree exists (populated OR empty). The
  Phase 6 gate `check_no_workspace_dir` fails any run with a `quality/workspace/` tree present —
  an empty `workspace/` trains future-iteration agents on the wrong layout and is rejected too.
